items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was a good teacher, I met him and everything

ctx.x: They have a high school here, it’s called the Harvard School. It’s out on Coldwater Canyon. Yep, and he had a good, Mr. Margolis. He was a good teacher, I met him and everything, and like I say, he’s got a good teacher, that’s what he needs, he needs a good teacher. And he got him, Mr. Margolis. Then he went over to the Crossroads School. That’s one of the far out schools. You understand what I mean? He went over, he’s, then he went to Bennington.
